title: bugbot inbox
description: inbox.json, written by `bugbot inbox` to the run directory: open PRs whose review was requested from you (by name or through your teams) in the workspace's repositories, filtered by the hooks. Disposable: rebuilt on every run.

query.description: The GitHub search string, built from the hooks (draft, labels, stale_days as an updated: lower bound) and the workspace repositories.

searched.description: PRs the search returned, before the per-PR hooks.

items.description: PRs to review, grouped by repository (most recent activity first) and, inside a repository, most recent activity first.

hidden.description: PRs the search returned but a per-PR hook or an earlier decision left out, with why.

title.description: For display only; never fed to triage.

age_days.description: Days since the PR was opened.

active_days.description: Days since the last activity on the PR (updatedAt: commits, comments, reviews).

last_commit_at.description: Committer date of the head commit.

idle_days.description: Days since the head commit (what hooks.stale_days measures).

requested.description: Review requests that reach you: your login and your teams (org/slug).

direct.description: Requested from you by name, not only through a team.

reviewers.description: People counted by reviewers.max, same rule as triage.

reviewers_max.description: Effective hooks.reviewers.max for the repository (0: no limit).

ci.description: Required checks of the head, as `gh pr checks --required` buckets them: pass, fail, pending, none (no required check: CI not gating) or unread.

hidden_by.description: Only in `hidden`: what left the PR out.

rule.description: A hook (stale_days, exclude_teams, reviewers.max, ci), `decided` (this head already has a triage decision) or `config` (invalid repo config).
